cards.hint: Think about the genetic material copied for study
cards.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.
cards.stem: What material does PCR amplify in the lab

cards.hint: Consider what makes isolated pieces usable for analysis
cards.quote: studies of isolated pieces of DNA are nearly impossible without PCR amplification.
cards.stem: What is needed to study isolated pieces of DNA

cards.hint: Recall identity related lab work using amplified DNA
cards.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders.
cards.stem: Which laboratory procedure can use amplified material

cards.hint: Think about the yield of repeated cycles
options: more than one billion exact copies
cards.quote: is repeated as many as 30 or 40 times, leading to more than one billion exact copies of the original DNA segment.
cards.stem: What does repeated cycling create from the original segment
